purpose: Diagnostic evaluation of compositional Saudi message writing, not a population-level accuracy estimate
checkpoint_selection: Inspect only the four development cases, then choose the epoch checkpoint before opening holdout outputs. Break ties in favor of the earlier checkpoint.
review_dimensions: Each listed requirement met, missing or contradicted
Correct speaker/addressee and gender when stated
Natural Saudi wording suitable for the relationship
Ready to send without factual or grammatical repair
strict_case_pass: All three requirements met, no unsupported assertion, no role/gender error, and sendable Saudi text. Do not treat absence of a literal phrase as failure when meaning is preserved.
reviewer: Assistant assessment; independent human review pending. Anonymous candidates are provided for independent review.
failure_policy: Preserve existing adapters and publish honest evidence. A failed diagnostic is not grounds to silently promote a candidate. Any later tuning on this holdout turns it into development data and requires a fresh test set.
